psychological_meaning: Leather evokes a sense of resilience, dependability, and understated luxury. It is often associated with natural materials and craftsmanship, fostering feelings of stability and comfort. The color symbolizes durability, tradition, and a connection to the earth, offering a sense of security and groundedness.
